definitions: The act or process of increasing in size, scope, or intensity.
The act of making something appear greater or more important than it actually is.
The act of increasing the power, status, or wealth of an individual or group.
examples: The aggrandizement of the empire was a slow process.
His constant self-aggrandizement alienated his colleagues.
The aggrandizement of the company's assets led to a higher valuation.
